errors.text_span: wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen jährlich angeordnet sind
errors.evidence: The x-axis tick labels are spaced every two years (2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024), not annually.
The left y-axis, which applies to 'Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt' and 'Finanzpolitik', is scaled from 0 to 1,000. The description incorrectly uses the range of the right y-axis.
The right y-axis is scaled from 0 to 9,000, not 8,000.

errors.text_span: stellt den Wert des Werts des Indizes
errors.evidence: The phrase 'Wert des Werts' (value of the value) is awkward and repetitive.

errors.text_span: steigt bis Januar 2020 auf etwa 400 an
errors.evidence: For the 'Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt' line, the major peak occurs in mid-2020 and reaches a value of approximately 500, not 400 in January 2020.
The 'Finanzpolitik' line starts at a value of approximately 50 in early 2016, not 100.

errors.text_span: bleibt relativ stabil bei Werten zwischen 100 und 150 bis Januar 2020, bei dem sie auf 200 ansteigt
errors.evidence: The 'Finanzpolitik' line is not stable, fluctuating between roughly 50 and 150. More importantly, it does not peak at 200 in January 2020; its major peak is in mid-2020 at a value of approximately 450.

errors.text_span: Die Linie für die Handelspolitik ist schwarz
errors.evidence: The line for 'Handelspolitik' is purple/mauve. The black line represents 'Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt'.

errors.text_span: markiert anfang Januar 2016 bei etwa 150, steigt bis Januar 2020 auf etwa 400 an, sinkt weiter unregelmäßig bis Januar 2022 auf etwa 250
errors.evidence: The description of the 'Handelspolitik' line provides completely incorrect values. Using the correct right-hand y-axis, the line starts near 0, peaks around 200-250 in 2019/2020, and then drops back to near 0 until late 2024. The values 150, 400, and 250 are all incorrect.

errors.text_span: steigt dann im Januar 2024 wieder auf etwa 8.000 an
errors.evidence: The sharp increase for the 'Handelspolitik' line occurs after January 2024, towards the very end of the plotted period, and its peak value is closer to 8,500.
The description completely omits the dramatic, sharp increase in all three index lines at the very end of the time series (end of 2024), which is a key visual feature of the graph.
